title: AGNTCon + MCPCon North America
tagline: Help your community find the conference for people building and deploying AI agents.

text.linkedin: AGNTCon + MCPCon North America is coming to San Francisco on April 28 and 29. Join engineers, open source maintainers, founders, and technical leaders to talk about how teams build and run AI agents.
text.x: Building with AI agents or MCP? AGNTCon + MCPCon North America is in San Francisco on April 28 and 29.
text.bluesky: Save April 28 and 29 for AGNTCon + MCPCon North America in San Francisco. Meet the people building tools, protocols, and infrastructure for AI agents.

text.linkedin: How are teams evaluating agents, securing MCP integrations, and keeping systems reliable in production? AGNTCon + MCPCon North America brings builders together to compare technical approaches. April 28 and 29 in San Francisco.
text.x: Agent evaluations, MCP security, and production reliability are on the program at AGNTCon + MCPCon North America. April 28 and 29 in San Francisco.
text.bluesky: Working through agent reliability or MCP interoperability? Compare approaches with other builders at AGNTCon + MCPCon North America in San Francisco this April.

text.linkedin: If your team wants time to work through practical problems, take a look at AGNTCon + MCPCon North America. Planned workshops cover topics including agent observability, access boundaries, and enterprise governance. April 28 and 29 in San Francisco.
text.x: Looking for practical workshops on agent tooling? AGNTCon + MCPCon North America includes workshops on topics such as observability and access boundaries.
text.bluesky: Explore practical workshops on agent observability, security, and governance at AGNTCon + MCPCon North America, April 28 and 29 in San Francisco.

text.linkedin: Who else is working on the same problems your team is? AGNTCon + MCPCon North America brings together open source maintainers, infrastructure teams, and people deploying agents across their organizations. Share the event with someone you’d like to compare notes with.
text.x: Know someone building agent infrastructure or contributing to MCP? Pass along AGNTCon + MCPCon North America, April 28 and 29 in San Francisco.
text.bluesky: Open source maintainers and engineers building with agents are getting together in San Francisco on April 28 and 29. Share AGNTCon + MCPCon North America with your team.

newsletterBlurb.text: AGNTCon + MCPCon North America takes place April 28 and 29, 2027, at Moscone Center in San Francisco. Explore sessions on MCP, agent engineering, evaluations, security, and more.

cfp.body: Encourage your team to share what they’ve learned building or operating AI agents.
cfp.invitation: Have a lesson to share about MCP, agent evaluations, or running agents in production? Submit a talk for AGNTCon + MCPCon North America by January 18.
